name: Jefferson River (Twin Bridges)
blurb: Quiet brown-trout water. Slow compared with the Madison — and a lot less crowded.

sections.notes: Diversion dam just below Waterloo — rope or portage. Don't drift it blind.
sections.accessReview: Parsons Bridge is the Waterloo Road crossing beside Lost Tomahawk. A public portage and road-right-of-way ramp are documented by the canoe-trail organization, but the landing and its relationship to the diversion dam still need a dependable mapped location and current access check.

notices.title: Waterloo / Parsons diversion dam
notices.text: The Jefferson River Canoe Trail describes a boat ramp in the Waterloo Road right-of-way beside Lost Tomahawk and a public portage around the diversion. Locate the landing and portage before planning this trip; the bridge label alone does not identify a safe exit or launch.
notices.sourceName: Jefferson River Canoe Trail — Lost Tomahawk

sections.notes: Parrot Castle has no boat ramp and difficult river access in the official FWP record. Do not rely on it as a take-out until a suitable replacement is confirmed.
